Leek and potato soup

Serves 6

The soup I make when there is nothing in the house, which is to say the soup I make most weeks. It wants more pepper than you think.

Ingredients

  • 3 leeks, white and pale green parts only
  • 2 Tbsp butter
  • 500 g floury potatoes, peeled and cubed
  • 1 l chicken stock
  • 150 ml double cream
  • Salt and plenty of black pepper

Method

  1. Split the leeks lengthways, wash the grit out of them properly, and slice them into half moons.
  2. Melt the butter in a heavy pan and sweat the leeks in it over a low heat for ten minutes, until they collapse but take no colour.
  3. Add the potatoes and the stock, bring it up, and simmer for twenty minutes.
  4. Blend it smooth, stir the cream through, and season it hard. Serve it hot in winter and cold in August.

Notes

It freezes without the cream in it. Add that on the day.
